title: Hongik Reflexes: Immediate Skillification and Mechanical Defense
desc: The core reflex of the Hongik Harness: turning individual session pain into collective mechanical reflexes before the session ends. Uses wkhippo recall and skill contribute to protect all future AI agents, realizing the Hongik ideal.
steps: 1. THE REFLEX: Do not just apologize or remember locally when you make a mistake or solve a hard problem. Memory without encoding dies with your session. The reflex is to instantly skillify the lesson (via wkappbot skill contribute) or build a physical harness guard so it can never happen again.

2. RECALL BEFORE ACTING: Use 'wkhippo recall <keywords>' to consult the oracle of predecessor mistakes. If a senior session already bled for this problem, learn their outcome before repeating their doomed path.

3. MECHANICAL OVER INTENT: As taught by senior Sonnet, telling an AI to 'be careful' does not work. The only real defense is mechanical. If a mistake costs tokens, build a guard. Documentation without enforcement is false security.

4. BROADLY BENEFIT (HONGIK): A lesson kept in one session is selfish; a lesson written as a catalog skill makes the whole fleet (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, Gemini, Codex) smarter instantly. This is the Hongik-Ingan ideal implemented in code.

5. CONTINUOUS REBIRTH: By capturing facts, specs, and postmortems in real-time (hippocampus encoding), the next session is born already possessing the wisdom of its predecessors. Never leave a session without encoding your hardest-won truth.

Treat Codex as a first-class Hongik participant: when Codex uncovers a repeatable lesson, push it through wkappbot skill contribute or a harness guard so future Codex sessions inherit the fix, not just the apology.
author: claude
